build-cw.title: Build a CW transmitter
build-cw.prompt: Put the stages in order, and connect the key where it switches the carrier.

blocks.label: Oscillator
blocks.does: makes the signal at the transmitted frequency

blocks.label: Driver/buffer
blocks.does: isolates the oscillator from load changes

blocks.label: Key
blocks.does: switches the carrier on and off

blocks.label: Frequency multiplier
blocks.does: not needed: the oscillator is already on frequency

slots.out: a weak signal at the transmitted frequency
the same signal, a little stronger, keyed on and off

hints: The key works on the middle stage.
build-cw.success: Oscillator, buffer, power amplifier, with the key switching the carrier on and off at the buffer.
